title: Combat Tips
tips: Use the weapon wheel (L1/LB) to quickly switch between weapons mid-fight.
Aim for headshots to conserve ammo — body shots take 2-3x more bullets.
Eat snacks (inventory) during combat to regain health on the fly.
Use cover (R1/RB) when outnumbered — pop out to shoot, then return to cover.
Propane tanks and gas pumps explode when shot — use them as environmental weapons.
Switch between Jason and Lucia mid-firefight to flank enemies from different angles.

title: Exploration Tips
tips: Explore at night — Vice City's neon-lit streets are best experienced after dark.
Check under bridges and in alleyways for hidden collectibles.
Swim out to sea — underwater areas contain hidden items and Easter eggs.
Visit the beach during sunrise for unique NPC activities and encounters.
Climb to the top of the tallest buildings for panoramic views and photo ops.
Use the in-game camera to discover hidden details in the environment.

title: Money Tips
tips: Complete side missions early — they often pay as well as main story missions.
Rob stores with a partner for double the take (Jason + Lucia co-op).
Invest in properties as early as possible — passive income adds up quickly.
Sell stolen cars at Pay & Spray for quick cash, but rare cars are worth more kept.
Complete all side activities to unlock unique money-making opportunities.
The stock market (if available) can be manipulated by completing certain missions.

title: Character Tips
tips: Switch between characters frequently — each has unique abilities and perspectives.
Jason's backstory with the army means he's better at combat situations.
Lucia's street smarts make her ideal for stealth and social engineering missions.
Build relationships with supporting characters — they unlock unique side content.
Check character-specific phone messages for hints about upcoming missions.
Each character has unique dialogue in the same situations — replay missions to hear both.
